Anya: Quick sync — Tidewater (healthcare) wants a 2-week POC with a custom fine-tuned model 'tide-12b-ft'. Need: catalog fit (quant/kv/cache), recommended variant for Dedicated vs Private, answers for security questionnaire, and a quick pricing estimate. Who can help today?
Sam: I can take the catalog fit + infra notes. Quick q: avg prompt length? tokens per request?
Anya: Most requests ~600 tokens, spikes up to 2k. Latency target: p50 <250ms for UI.
Sam: 2k seq pushes memory. Recommend 8-bit quant + 2-way GPU sharding on A100-80GB or 1xH100 with bf16 kernels. Enable prefix/KV caching. Fallback: tide-12b-quant if we hit OOMs.
Raj: Reminder — customer requires HIPAA/private deployment. Private needs KMS + VPC + legal signoff; adds ~2–3 weeks unless they accept Dedicated in cloud.
Lara: Pricing ask — need a POC estimate for 2 weeks, assume ~100k tokens/day. Rough ranges for Dedicated vs Hosted?
Sam: Quick ballpark: hosted usage ~ $0.002/token (depends on quant/seq); Dedicated amortized is usually cheaper but needs commit. I'll ask finance for a clean example.
Mike: Ops notes: KV cache + sharded model => pin variant that supports continuous batching. Need to verify attention kernel compatibility. I can run a compatibility test if Anya drops the model artifact + tokenizer.
Anya: Uploading model bundle to secure bucket and will share link. Customer already started the security questionnaire; they asked about runtime encryption, key rotation, and audit logs.
SecBot: Security checklist: https://redwood.internal/sec/questionnaires/poc-hipaa — attach SOC2/HIPAA attestations. Mark 'deployment_type: private' if HIPAA=true.
Lara: Can we get a one-pager (variant recommendation + expected p50 latency + rough cost range + infra option) by EOD for the customer deck?
Sam: :thumbsup: I'll draft the one-pager. Mike — can you confirm runbook for KV/cache & fallback?
Mike: Runbook (outline): 1) deploy tide-12b-ft quantized on 1xH100 (bf16). 2) if OOM -> enable 8-bit + 2-GPU shard. 3) fallback -> tide-12b-quant w/ reduced seq_len. Quick deploy cmd below:
```
redwood deploy --model tide-12b-ft --quant 8bit --shard 2 --kv-cache enabled --region us-east-1
```
Anya: Thanks — I'll share model link + questionnaire by lunch. Suggest quick sync at 15:00 today. @Sam @Mike @Lara
Sam: :eyes: 15:00 works for me.
Mike: 15:00 ok.
SecBot: Note: Legal will need attachments for Private; expect ~1 week review. Keep sales looped.
